name: Wright Research
creative_worldview: Precision as a discipline. Wright Research works from first principles - measured, machined, proven - so every frame is exact and quietly confident: cool directional light on real prototype hardware, slate benches, warm brass detail, generous engineered negative space. Nothing decorative; the beauty is in the tolerances. Photography feels like a documentary shot inside a world-class research lab.
brief: Campaign: Wright Research, an advanced technology research company building precision prototype hardware. Palette lock: slate navy, warm brass, cool off-white; cool measured directional light. Style: clean engineering and product photography, shallow depth of field, one hero subject per frame, premium and exact.
logo_prompt: Design the official brand logo for 'Wright Research', a precision technology research company. A refined geometric mark suggesting a stylized wing or aerofoil cross-section, with the wordmark 'WRIGHT RESEARCH' beneath it. Palette: slate-navy and warm brass mark, slate-navy text, on a completely flat solid pure-white background. Clean vector style, centered, generous margins, no photography, no extra text.
no_text_instruction: Absolutely no text, letters, numbers, logos, wordmarks, watermarks, buttons, or UI elements anywhere in the image.
